Package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.motor

@NullMarked package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.motor
Board-independent motor contracts. Motor provides open-loop power control, Encoder provides position feedback, and RegulatedMotor adds encoder-backed speed and position control. Concrete adapters belong under the relevant board or device package and must preserve these primitive, allocation-free contracts.
